summary.tldr: Gives effect to a self-government treaty with the Whitecap Dakota Nation / Wapaha Ska Dakota Oyate and makes related changes to other laws.
what_it_does: Gives effect to the treaty entitled “A Self-Government Treaty Recognizing the Whitecap Dakota Nation / Wapaha Ska Dakota Oyate”.
Makes consequential amendments to other Acts.
who_it_affects: Whitecap Dakota Nation / Wapaha Ska Dakota Oyate
summary.background: The Minister of Crown-Indigenous Relations introduced the bill on 16 June 2023, and it received first reading in the House of Commons.
